property_summary: Filling any order must set the stored position expiration to fill-time block.timestamp plus order.duration (> block.timestamp); the mutant stores block.timestamp - duration, so for any duration > 0 the stored expiration is wrong (already in the past).
change_summary: Replace the stored expiration value `block.timestamp + order.duration` with `block.timestamp - order.duration`, writing an already-expired (and different) value at the same key.
